name: Lawrence
source:
A man who lives in place of a priest at a church in the city.
He lives there with the orphan Elric.
He asks the hero to search for a "figurine" taken out of the church.

[From [url=https://www.otomate.jp/psychedelica/aa-nisus/chara/?page=lawrence]official website[/url]]
